name: Ochibana Souto
source:
A meddlesome yet honest boy

A boy who awakens alongside Zena in the same mysterious place. Watching over Zena, he provides support along the way.
His meddlesome nature won't let him ignore someone in trouble.
He regrets not being able to take the hand of his childhood friend who died of an illness when he was young.

"If you're in, I'll be here to back you up."


[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
